calls.reconciliation: The three runs agree on every checkable fact: P0 = Nov 6 close, P1 = Nov 20 close, NVDA earnings on Nov 17 AMC inside the window, NVDA $186.71 on Nov 6, and implied move ~±9%. One factual discrepancy: MarketBeat lists Nov 18 rather than Nov 17. It doesn't matter, because either date falls inside the window. The real disagreements are judgment calls: how much mass to put outside ±15 (Run 1 ~19%, Runs 2-3 ~11-12%), and whether the implied vol has risen since the late-October quote (likely yes, as Run 1's Nov 6 figure of ±9.03% suggests). Converting the straddle to a spread sigma of ~9.5pp gives ~12% normal tail mass beyond ±15, a little more with fat tails. So I took ~13.5% total escape mass: between the runs, but derived from the vol calculation rather than averaged from them. I kept the conditional percentiles near the runs' consensus body, which fits a fat-tailed distribution. I retrieved nothing new on this run.
